title.english: A Map That Leaves Someone Out

pairs.target: yīwén xiě le liǎngtào zì , dìyītào zuì qízhěng , dìèrtào gǎi le sānchù , jǐ dé mòwěi xiàng cǎi le bǐcǐ de jiǎo .
pairs.english: Iven wrote two versions. The first was neatest; three edits made the second's ending look like words stepping on each other's feet.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文写了两套字，第一套最齐整，第二套改了三处，挤得末尾像踩了彼此的脚。

pairs.target: tā jiāng dìyīzhāng fàngzài zhuōbiān , shuōhǎo dú zǒng gāi suàn yíxiàng , mǐlā què xiān ná qǐ dìèrzhāng , zhǐzhe qízhōng yíjù , wèn shuí shì " běnzhàn hòu zhuǎn zhě ". "
pairs.english: Good readability ought to count, he said, setting the first aside, but Mira picked up the second and asked who “persons awaiting transfer at this station” meant.
pairs.hanzi:
他将第一张放在桌边，说好读总该算一项，米拉却先拿起第二张，指着其中一句，问谁是“本站候转者”。
“

pairs.target: zài zhèlǐ děng zhuǎnchē de rén . "
pairs.english: “People waiting here to change carts,”
pairs.hanzi: 在这里等转车的人。”

pairs.target: tā shuō .
pairs.english: He said.
pairs.hanzi: 他说。

pairs.target: " nà wèihé bú zhème xiě ? "
pairs.english: “Then why not write that?”
pairs.hanzi: “那为何不这么写？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuán xiǎng xiào , jiàn yīwén liǎnhóng , yòu jiāng xiào rěnzhù .
pairs.english: Tavi started laughing, then held back at Iven's flushed face.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原想笑，见伊文脸红，又将笑忍住。

pairs.target: yīwén búshì bùkěn gǎi , zhǐshì juéde tāmen yì gǎi , páizi biàn xiàng fànpù ménkǒu jīnrì mài shénme de zhǐ .
pairs.english: Iven would change it, but felt the revisions made the sign resemble an eatery's daily menu sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文不是不肯改，只是觉得他们一改，牌子便像饭铺门口今日卖什么的纸。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō fànpù nà zhāng zhǐ zhìshǎo ràng rén zhīdào néng bunéng chī , yīwén huí tā , ruò shuí dōu suíbiàn xiě , chēzhàn de míngzì chízǎo yě gěi xiě méi le .
pairs.english: At least the eatery's sheet told people whether they could eat, Mira said. If anyone wrote freely, Iven answered, even the station name would eventually disappear.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说饭铺那张纸至少让人知道能不能吃，伊文回她，若谁都随便写，车站的名字迟早也给写没了。

pairs.target: zhēng dào zhèlǐ , tǎ wéi jiāng zìjǐ de tú tuīchū lái .
pairs.english: At this point in the argument, Tavi offered his own drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 争到这里，塔维将自己的图推出来。

pairs.target: zì biān pèi yígè wūdǐng , yíliàngchē , děnghòu de wèizhì tú cū , búbì quán kào zì .
pairs.english: A roof and cart beside the words, the waiting place thickly marked, meant less dependence on text.
pairs.hanzi: 字边配一个屋顶，一辆车，等候的位置涂粗，不必全靠字。

pairs.target: yīwén kàn le , shuō wūdǐng hòumiàn nà yíkuài hēi de xiàng lìng yíliàngchē .
pairs.english: Iven said the black patch behind the roof looked like another cart.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文看了，说屋顶后面那一块黑的像另一辆车。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō nà shì chángdèng , mǐlā còujìn , yě xiān rènchéng le xiāngzǐ .
pairs.english: A bench, Tavi said, but Mira too saw a crate first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说那是长凳，米拉凑近，也先认成了箱子。

pairs.target: tā jí zhe jiěshì , yuè jiěshì yuè xiàng duìfāng bùkěn kàn .
pairs.english: His urgent explanations increasingly sounded as if they refused to look.
pairs.hanzi: 他急着解释，越解释越像对方不肯看。

pairs.target: mǐlā shēnshǒu ànzhù zhǐ , shuō tāmen kěn tīng tā jiǎng , bù děngyú xīn lái de rén dōu néng xiān tīng tā jiǎng .
pairs.english: Mira pressed the paper: their willingness to listen didn't mean every newcomer could hear his explanation first.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉伸手按住纸，说他们肯听他讲，不等于新来的人都能先听他讲。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng shǒu suōhuílái , hūrán juéde yīwén gāngcái hànwèi nà yítào zì shí , liǎnshàng dàgài yě shì zìjǐ cǐkè zhè fù yàngzi .
pairs.english: Tavi withdrew his hand, feeling Iven defending his wording earlier must have worn this very expression.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将手缩回来，忽然觉得伊文刚才捍卫那一套字时，脸上大概也是自己此刻这副样子。

pairs.target: zuìhòu dài qù jiù péng shì de bìngfēi shuí yuánlái nà zhāng .
pairs.english: The version taken to trial was nobody's original.
pairs.hanzi: 最后带去旧棚试的并非谁原来那张。

pairs.target: zhànmíng liúzài dǐngshàng , xiàmiàn yòng duǎnjù fēn " huànchē děnghòu " yǔ " chū péng xiàpō ", liǎngchù gè pèi yìgēn néng duì shàng zhù biān shíchù de jiàntóu ; tú xiān bú huà zhěngzuò wū , zhī huà dāngxià kàndéjiàn de nàgēn zhùzi , réngxū nágěi rén zǒuguò cái suàn .
pairs.english: Station name above, short phrases “wait for connecting cart” and “exit downhill” below, each with an arrow tied to an actual point beside the post. No whole roof picture yet, only the visible post; people still had to walk it for a trial.
pairs.hanzi: 站名留在顶上，下面用短句分“换车等候”与“出棚下坡”，两处各配一根能对上柱边实处的箭头；图先不画整座屋，只画当下看得见的那根柱子，仍须拿给人走过才算。

pairs.target: duàn yí gěi le xià yì bānchē lái qián de yìxiǎo duàn kōngdàng , línshí zhǐpái kě guà , chē jiāng dào biàn qǔ xià .
pairs.english: Duan gave a short quiet slot before the next cart: signs could hang temporarily, then come down before arrival.
pairs.hanzi: 段姨给了下一班车来前的一小段空档，临时纸牌可挂，车将到便取下。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī tóng lái , dài liǎngmíng yuànyì bāngmáng de xuéshēng , yì rén zhī zhīdào zìjǐ yào zhuǎnchē , yì rén zhī zhīdào yào dào pō xià bù pù , méiyǒu xiān tīng tāmen zěnyàng shèjì .
pairs.english: Jian brought two willing students as visitors, one knowing only a transfer destination, the other the downhill cloth shop, neither briefed on the design.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师同来，带两名愿意帮忙的学生，一人只知道自己要转车，一人只知道要到坡下布铺，没有先听他们怎样设计。

pairs.target: dìyī rén cóng chē tíng de dìfāng zǒu , kàndào jiàntóu biàn jìn péng , zhàn dào tāmen quān de děnghòu chù , méi dǎngzhù zhuǎnshēn .
pairs.english: The first walked from the cart stop, followed the arrow inside and waited in their marked spot clear of turning traffic.
pairs.hanzi: 第一人从车停的地方走，看到箭头便进棚，站到他们圈的等候处，没挡住转身。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xīnlǐ yì xǐ , dìèr rén què cóng cèmén páng qǐbù , zǒu dào zhù biān , kànjiàn pái shàng " chū péng " èr zì , fǎnwèn zìjǐ gāng cóng wàitou lái , wèihé hái déchū yìhuí .
pairs.english: Tavi rejoiced, but the second started by the side door, reached the post and asked why “exit” required leaving again when she'd just come from outside.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维心里一喜，第二人却从侧门旁起步，走到柱边，看见牌上“出棚”二字，反问自己刚从外头来，为何还得出一回。

pairs.target: yīwén zài běn shàng xiān xiěxià zhè jù huà , méi gěi zìjǐ nà jù biànhù .
pairs.english: Iven wrote that question down first without defending his wording.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文在本上先写下这句话，没给自己那句辩护。

pairs.target: mǐlā qǐng tóngxué bié zhào tāmen yùxiǎng zǒu , zhī zhǐ zìjǐ zhēn yǐwéi gāi zǒu de fāngxiàng .
pairs.english: Mira asked the student to point where she would actually go, not follow their expectation.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉请同学别照他们预想走，只指自己真以为该走的方向。

pairs.target: nà rén cóng zhǐpái lìngyícè ràoguòqù , shǒulǐ de lán yán cā zhe zhùjiǎo , jiàntóu kànshàngqù cháo xià , zhēn yào zhuǎn dào bù pū lùkǒu , què hái chà bàngè wān .
pairs.english: She circled the other side of the sign, basket rim brushing the post foot. The arrow seemed downhill, but another half-turn remained to reach the cloth-shop path.
pairs.hanzi: 那人从纸牌另一侧绕过去，手里的篮沿擦着柱脚，箭头看上去朝下，真要转到布铺路口，却还差半个弯。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūn dào tā yuánlái zhàn de wèizhì , zhōngyú kànjiàn zìjǐ huà duì le yíchù , lòu le lìng yíchù .
pairs.english: Crouching where she'd stood, Tavi finally saw one part right, another missing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲到她原来站的位置，终于看见自己画对了一处，漏了另一处。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhěngzhāng lù tú liúzài bǎn shàng , zhī zài shìyòng zhǐpái hòumiàn zhùmíng cèmén qǐdiǎn wèi biànqīng .
pairs.english: He kept the whole route drawing on the board, adding only “side-door starting point unclear” behind the trial sign.
pairs.hanzi: 他把整张路图留在板上，只在试用纸牌后面注明侧门起点未辨清。

pairs.target: chēfū yǐjīng zài yuǎnchù jiào , duàn yí cháo tāmen bǎishǒu , sān rén gǎnjǐn qǔ pái , méiyǒu yīn gāngshì chū yìdiǎn hǎochù jiù duō guà yìbān .
pairs.english: A driver called in the distance. At Duan's wave they hurriedly removed the signs, not leaving them another departure because one part had worked.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫已经在远处叫，段姨朝他们摆手，三人赶紧取牌，没有因刚试出一点好处就多挂一班。

pairs.target: huíqù de lùshang , yīwén wèn jīnwǎn shìbushì háiyào zhòngxiě .
pairs.english: On the way back Iven asked if they would rewrite tonight.
pairs.hanzi: 回去的路上，伊文问今晚是不是还要重写。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō yào , tǎ wéi yě shuō yào .
pairs.english: Mira said yes, and Tavi said yes too.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说要，塔维也说要。

pairs.target: shuōwán liǎng rén yìqí kàn xiàng yīwén , tā tànqì , jiào tāmen shuí dōu bié xiān tì tā pào yìbēi tíshén de kǔ chá , zìjǐ huì qù ná , sāngè rén zǒng bùnéng zhī kào yígè rén qīngxǐng zhe bǎ zì xiě wán .
pairs.english: After both spoke, they looked at Iven together. Sighing, he told them not to brew him bitter waking tea first: he would get it himself. Three people couldn't write everything with just one person awake.
pairs.hanzi: 说完两人一齐看向伊文，他叹气，叫他们谁都别先替他泡一杯提神的苦茶，自己会去拿，三个人总不能只靠一个人清醒着把字写完。
